description: All-OpenAI family picks on the official OpenAI API — gpt-6 line (released 2026-09-22, 1M context, text+image+pdf inputs): gpt-6-luna at $0.1/$0.5 explores on flash and takes vision, gpt-6-sol at $2/$10 carries standard/pro/max — cheaper and stronger than gpt-5.6-terra ($2/$12); the 6-line dropped terra, so sol doubles as the orchestration tier. gpt-6-astra ($10/$50) breaches the $3/$15 cost red line and is excluded. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable.
